summary: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical filed an 8-K reporting an October 6, 2026 asset purchase agreement to sell a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher to an unnamed buyer for $210 million cash at closing. The PRV was awarded by the FDA on August 19, 2026 with the GENGLYCOS (DTX401) approval for GSDIa. Under a 2018 NIH patent license, 20% of gross proceeds is payable to NIH post-closing. Closing is conditioned on HSR waiting-period expiration; full agreement to be filed with the 2026 10-K. Watch HSR timing and net proceeds versus the NIH share.
